title: Lecturer on Oral Medicine, Infection, and Immunity
bio: Dr. Jerry C. Lin received his certificate in periodontology and Doctor of Medical Sciences in oral biology from the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. He is board-certified and a diplomate of the American Board of Periodontology. Lin is a lecturer at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine, an assistant professor at Taipei Medical University, and a clinical instructor at National Taiwan University Hospital. Since 2007, he has led the periodontal literature review course at National Taiwan University. He is also president of the Academy of Dental Implantology, ROC, and past vice president of the Taipei Dental Association. Lin is the founder and director of the Institute for Advanced Dental Education (iADE), which has offered advanced courses in comprehensive periodontics and implant dentistry since 2007. In addition to his commitment to dental education, he maintains a private practice in Taipei.
